description: Labour unrest in the tech sector escalates into coordinated strike actions across multiple EU member states, led by unions demanding enforceable transition guarantees for displaced workers and a moratorium on AI adoption in public-sector hiring. The movement gains traction as white-collar professionals join blue-collar workers in protest, framing AI-driven displacement as a systemic failure of governance. The visibility of the unrest increases pressure on the EU to act on social absorption measures.
